headline: Travis Scott went from being in front of the camera to filming Future’s alternate “YA HIT”
body: Travis Scott went from being in front of the camera to filming Future’s alternate “YA HIT” video himself Recorded at Area 29, the alternate visual has Travis behind the lens using his own camera. A Future video filmed by La Flame is a linkup we’ll take How’d Travis do on camera duty?
